title: Deeper/broader peer issue shapes and HATCH CMC read/write symmetry
mode: primary-source issue review plus local source/test crosswalk; plan-only refinement
scope: Re-read selected LibreDWG issues #1408, #1409, #1410, and #1415 and ACadSharp issues #1259, #1261, and #1277
Compare reported DXF text framing, block-body, HATCH/embedded-MTEXT, codepage, GeoData, and MLEADER-context shapes with existing local owners
Trace local R2004+ HATCH gradient CMC read and write paths against ODA §2.11 and the existing CMC writer helper
Refine PAR-134 implementation readiness without adding a duplicate finding or broadening support claims

method.kind: Read primary project issue bodies and official format/API references; inspect local source and current plan/test coverage
method.limitations: Peer issues are reports for the named peer versions/routes, not format authority or local reproductions. The HATCH reader/writer finding is source-confirmed but its generated end-to-end vectors have not yet been executed. No peer or native runtime comparison was performed.

sources.observed: R2004+ CMC has a reserved BS index that is always zero, a packed BL carrying color/method, and an RC flags byte. HATCH gradient stops use this CMC-shaped sequence.
The packed color high byte identifies the method; low color bytes carry components. This distinguishes C2 true color from C3 indexed color.

sources.observed: The report distinguishes C3 ACI palette collisions from C2 true-color fallback errors and corrects an initially proposed fix that would have guarded the reserved BS instead of preserving method semantics. Used only to choose generated adversarial values.

sources.revision: Open issue bodies retrieved 2026-10-18; issue #1409 report names LibreDWG 0.14 and source revision 8a1ae7646
sources.observed: Reports cover literal-CR DXF framing, skipped BLOCK bodies from loop-index mutation, and three distinct DXF→DWG cases: zero-valued HATCH coordinates, unusual attribute tags, and embedded-MTEXT fields. The embedded-field skip is described by its reporter as a stopgap.

sources.observed: The reports separate codepage declaration/byte mismatch, an R2009 GeoData tail and unit-field assignment, and standalone annotative MLEADER context-object corruption. They remain peer-specific implementation leads.

sources.observed: DRW_Hatch::readBoundedHatchGradient assigns the R2004+ BS to aciColor and the packed BL to rgb; encodeDwgGradientData writes those fields untagged. dwgBufferW::putCmColor already implements BS=0 with packed C2/C3 methods. Existing neighboring route owners cover LAYER CMC, block census, text framing, HATCH zero-Y, embedded attributes, CP949, GeoData, and standalone MLEADER context boundaries.
